description: ADO-PARAM, text command 'SELECT ID FROM K WHERE ID >= ? AND ID <= ?' with fresh parameters named 'hi' (value 4) then 'lo' (value 2): the names are the reverse of the intended roles, the values discriminate. Run with NamedParameters False and with True; Execute and all rows each. A row set 2..4 means name matters; empty means position.
